name: malformed
description:
REGRESSION LOCK ON A DEFECT, NOT A PASSING BEHAVIOUR. The asset search answers 200 with a bare JSON array where an object carrying "items" is documented -- the shape a gateway or a changed API version returns. `data.get("items", [])` on a list is not recoverable in Starlark: it aborts the whole run with "list has no .get field or method", so the integration fails with no diagnosis rather than stopping cleanly. The same hole exists at `_get_access_token` (`data.get("accessToken")`) and inside the item loop (a string element in `items` aborts with "string has no .get field or method").

The fix is the guard stairwell, lima-charlie and extreme-cloud-iq already carry: `if type(data) != "dict": print(...); break`. This scenario asserts the current abort so that the day the guard is added it fails and gets updated to expect a clean stop with zero assets.

log_contains: list has no .get field or method
